lines: On 2026-09-10, the WhatsApp reminder went out in the older layout, **"project_checkin"**, because the newer one, **"project_checkin_v2"**, could not be used: Meta has paused it because people rated it poorly. To check it, run `python -m reminder --whatsapp-template-status` in the second-brain folder.
